items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Miss Kimball was with Robichardt... and she played the piano. Well them was about the only ones I know, you know, piano players.

ctx.x: Well who were some of the piano players you knew then who were working alone or with

a singer? Well Mr. Todd, I know Steve Lewis with P-Rone, and Miss Kimball was with Robichardt, and his wife and his husband played trumpet, Kimball and Miss Kimball, and she played the piano. Well them was about the only ones I know, you know, piano players. They had guys used like Pichon, well he always had a job by himself in the clubs you know, Walter Pichon, you know him. Yeah.
I just wondered who some of the ones that were in the district here, you told me you worked
